visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled dark hair and subtle eyeliner looks to the side against a grey studio background, transitioning to a frontal view where the text 'IMPROVISE' is overlaid across his chest. (2) He holds a black KAIBEAUTY eyeliner pen horizontally in front of his face, then begins drawing intricate, vine-like lines around his eye area with steady hand movements. (3) The scene cuts to him applying a liquid product from his hand to his face with a brush, followed by shots of him using a small eyeshadow palette and another brush to shade the areas around the eyeliner designs. (4) He uses a large fluffy brush to apply powder or blush from a larger palette, then closes his eyes as he sprays a mist of setting spray over his face. (5) The man poses from multiple angles (front, side, three-quarter) to showcase the finished artistic eye makeup look while holding the eyeliner pen near his jawline as promotional text appears at the bottom.
